title: Sales Order Agent: ignore attachments larger than 25 MB during email retrieval
summary: Sales Order Agent now ignores email attachments larger than 25 MB during retrieval and replaces them with placeholder notes to prevent email processing failures when oversized files are encountered.
key_points: Attachment sizes are checked before content retrieval using EmailMessage.Attachments_GetLength()
Oversized attachments are replaced with small placeholder text files ending in .ignored.txt
Only non-ignored attachments are copied to sales quotes during attachment transfer
New enum value ExceedsFileSize added to SOA Email Attachment Status to track ignore reason
Telemetry is emitted for ignored attachments with original file details
